subtitle: Platform accounts and their connection status. Credentials are managed exclusively as server-side environment variables and are never stored in the frontend. Access tokens are encrypted before being stored in the database once connected.
disconnectConfirm: Really disconnect this account? You'll need to reconnect it via "Connect" afterwards.
needsCredentialsNote: Still missing: set {idVar} and {secretVar} in Render.
errorNotConfigured: {platform}: app credentials are missing. Get an API key under "Integrations" and set it in Render.
errorEncryptionMissing: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set on the server — required to securely store access tokens before an account can be connected.
errorInvalidState: Connection failed (invalid security code). Please try again.
errorExchangeFailed: Connection failed. Check the credentials and try again.
encryptionKeyMissingNotice: Note: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set yet — accounts can only be connected once this environment variable is set in Render.
